review.purpose: Validate the chosen local model and label selected passages with its catalog-reported weight license before interpreting scores.
review.finding: The complete five-row registry yields one exact MiniLM match. The selected row gates scoring and carries model/license into result rows; assertions enforce unique model names and consistent labels. Immutable weight revision is verified separately. Other advertised models are neither downloaded nor benchmarked; the license string is provenance only.

review.purpose: Show why a local reranker cannot recover a passage absent from its bounded candidate set.
review.finding: A materialized authored prefix precedes actual local model inference. Default four inputs produce three scores and one NULL; widening to eight admits six usable passages and two NULLs. The planted direct answer becomes eligible; measured ranking and chosen text are interpreted without an accuracy or probability claim. Excluded versus NULL versus negative scores stay separate, and fourteen SQL checks cover preservation/ordering/provenance. Query, model snapshot and final selection size stay fixed.
